characters.name: सावित्री
characters.role: the princess who argues with Death
characters.look: slim young woman, red sari, hair tied back, calm eyes

characters.name: सत्यवान
characters.role: the husband with one year to live
characters.look: young woodcutter, simple dhoti, axe on shoulder

characters.name: यमराज
characters.look: dark-skinned, red-eyed, red robe, noose in hand

hookAdvisory.note: Hook states as flat fact that a bride knowingly married a man with one year left, which is the paradox.

lines.text: एक राजकुमारी ने जान-बूझकर ऐसे आदमी से शादी की, जिसके पास बस एक साल था।
lines.gloss: A princess knowingly married a man who had only one year left.

look.note: Savitri stands alone in the palace courtyard, garland in hand.

lines.text: सावित्री राजा की बेटी थी, तेज दिमाग और ठंडे मन वाली। नारद जी ने साफ चेतावनी दी थी।
lines.gloss: Savitri was a king's daughter, sharp-minded and cool-hearted. Sage Narada had warned her plainly.

look.note: Savitri sits by the mango tree, listening with a still face.

lines.text: सत्यवान जंगल में लकड़ी काटता था, सीधा-सादा और बेहद नेक। शादी के बाद सावित्री ने दिन गिनने शुरू किए।
lines.gloss: Satyavan cut wood in the forest, simple and very virtuous. After the wedding Savitri began counting days.

look.note: Satyavan walks past the hut doorway with an axe on his shoulder.

lines.text: एक साल बीता, और जंगल में सत्यवान के सिर में दर्द उठा। वह पेड़ के नीचे बैठ गया।
lines.gloss: A year passed, and in the forest Satyavan's head began to ache. He sat down under a tree.

look.note: Satyavan sits in the clearing, one hand pressed to his head.

lines.text: तभी एक काला-साँवला, लाल आँखों वाला आदमी लाल कपड़ों में आया। हाथ में फंदा था, और वह खुद यमराज था।
lines.gloss: Then a dark man with red eyes came dressed in red. He held a noose, and he was Yama himself.

look.note: Yama stands at the clearing edge, noose in hand, facing Satyavan.

lines.text: यमराज बोले, "मैं दूत नहीं भेजता, क्योंकि यह आत्मा बहुत पवित्र है।" सावित्री पीछे खड़ी सब सुन रही थी।
lines.gloss: Yama said, "I do not send messengers, because this soul is too pure." Savitri stood behind, hearing everything.

look.note: Yama speaks at the clearing while Savitri stands behind him.

lines.text: उसने सत्यवान की जान शरीर से खींची, फंदे में बाँधी और दक्षिण की ओर चल दिया। सावित्री पैदल पीछे चल पड़ी।
lines.gloss: He drew Satyavan's life from his body, bound it in the noose and walked south. Savitri followed on foot.

look.note: Yama walks away with the noose while Savitri follows behind.

lines.text: सावित्री ने हाथ नहीं उठाया, बस चलती रही और तर्क करती रही। यमराज उसकी बातों से प्रसन्न हो गए।
lines.gloss: Savitri did not raise a hand, she just kept walking and reasoning. Yama grew pleased with her words.

look.note: Savitri speaks while walking beside Yama in the clearing.

lines.text: पहले तीन वरदान मिले, पर सत्यवान की जान अलग रखी गई। फिर चौथा वरदान माँगा गया, और यमराज ने हाँ कह दी?
lines.gloss: The first three boons came, but Satyavan's life was kept aside. Then a fourth boon was asked, and Yama said yes?

look.note: Yama extends an open hand toward Savitri in the clearing.

lines.text: दरअसल, चौथा वरदान था सत्यवान से सौ बेटे, और यमराज ने बिना सोचे हाँ कह दी। बेटे बिना पिता कैसे होंगे?
lines.gloss: You see, the fourth boon was a hundred sons from Satyavan, and Yama granted it without thinking. How can sons exist without a father?

look.note: Savitri points a finger at Yama in the clearing.

lines.text: यह वैसा ही है जैसे कोई दुकानदार लिख दे कि सामान कल मिलेगा, पर दुकान बंद रहेगी। शब्दों में फँसना पड़ता है।
lines.gloss: It is like a shopkeeper writing that goods will come tomorrow, but the shop stays shut. You have to get caught in your own words.

look.note: Savitri shrugs near the boats on the sand.

lines.text: यमराज ने फंदा खोला और सत्यवान को चार सौ साल की उम्र दी। सत्यवान जागा और पूछा, "वह काला आदमी कहाँ गया?"
lines.gloss: Yama untied the noose and gave Satyavan four hundred years of life. Satyavan woke and asked, "Where did that dark man go?"

look.note: Satyavan sits up in the clearing, looking around.

lines.text: सावित्री ने कहा कि जीत तलवार स
lines.gloss: Savitri said that victory comes not from the sword but from words.

look.note: Savitri stands in the clearing, calm and finished.
